hooks.command: f=$(jq -r '.tool_input.file_path // empty'); [ -z "$f" ] && exit 0; case "$f" in *.lua) sty=$(command -v stylua || echo ~/.local/share/nvim/mason/bin/stylua); [ -x "$sty" ] && "$sty" "$f" ;; esac; case "$f" in */lua/config/keymaps.lua) cd ~/.config/nvim && nvim --headless "+luafile scripts/dump-keymaps.lua" +qa ;; esac
